verdict.rationale: Connecting to MCP servers is a fair axis for an LLM serving engine, which could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the story applies. The evidence only documents tool-calling parsers and `tool_choice` support, which let the model emit function calls for the API caller to execute. That is an adjacent feature, not a documented ability to register MCP servers and use their tools, so there is no direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
